brief:
Israeli forces shot a child and wounded other Palestinians during military operations across multiple areas of the West Bank, the Shehab Wire reported. The incidents unfolded simultaneously in several locations throughout the occupied territory, marking another day of violence amid ongoing tensions.

The military operations resulted in injuries among civilians, including the child who was struck by gunfire. Further details about the scale of the incidents, the specific locations targeted, and the condition of those wounded remained unclear. The Shehab Wire did not immediately provide additional information about the circumstances surrounding each operation or the stated purpose of the military deployments.
